text_block_list.text: After our outing—
choice_data_list: I want to make you smile again!
I want to entertain you again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, in the first place, I didn't even 
enjoy that thing from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm getting dragged into that kind 
of childish playing again. Forget it.

I certainly failed before, but today I had 
a secret plan. I had learned that there 
was a smartphone game she's recently 
gotten hooked on.
choice_data_list: This time, we're settling it with 'RDLI'!

text_block_list.text:
"RDLI." An overseas PvP FPS game. Using a 
wide variety of weaponry, its tactical 
mind games over how to outplay your 
opponent are its main appeal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"RDLI"... I thought I was the only one 
around here playing it...

According to her roommate Super Creek, she 
had grumbled about having no opponents 
before. So, taking it upon herself, she 
grinded the game thoroughly.

"My chances of winning against her in a 
game she plays regularly are slim, but if 
I can put up a good fight, it might 
entertain her!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, fine with me.

Though I felt a slight sense of unease at 
how readily she agreed, we ended up facing 
off in a match, but—
――『You lose』

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yep, another win for me. That makes it 5 
wins out of 5.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so? Well, I have put quite a 
lot of time into it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Still... heh. You challenged me with such 
high spirits, yet you're way too weak."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Your choice of weapons and stages is a 
mess, and you don't even know how to use 
the NPCs. Did you actually configure your 
settings properly?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually play PvP mode, so I was 
curious to see how it'd go, but... you're 
barely even a match for me like this.

Narita Taishin was unusually talkative... 
Having found someone she could utterly 
crush, she seemed to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"It's boring if things stay like this... 
How about I give you a handicap?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Without missing a beat, huh? Don't you 
have any pride?
choice_data_list: Because I want to play with Taishin more

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

"At this rate, she'll end up getting 
bored. In order to grasp even the 
slightest chance of putting up a good 
fight, I told her I'd throw away my 
pride."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What was that? That's seriously so 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll only use the starting weapon. 
I'll lend you an SSR weapon. It'll be 
embarrassing if you lose with that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Well—
――『You lose』

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not that I'm gonna let you win, though.

In the end, no matter how many times I 
challenged Narita Taishin, I couldn't 
win... As I was reflecting on my defeat—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind hanging out with you again 
sometime, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The rewards from these matches are pretty 
sweet. ...Plus, beating the snot out of 
you feels pretty damn good too, ya know?

Her words were harsh, but Narita Taishin 
was giving me a chance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...? You really think you can beat me 
like this?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, they should just accept a handicap 
honestly. That way it might actually be a 
good match.
choice_data_list:
It's a fun game, so I want to do my best 
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...So you're not gonna say 'it takes too 
much brainpower,' or 'the controls make no 
sense,' or 'it's too brutal and scary'?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. Do your best, I guess.

Narita Taishin seemed to be in a slightly 
better mood than before, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Huh? I messed up the landing again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, jeez...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Watching you play is so frustrating! Right 
here, you should've used that item from 
before—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
âHere, this lets us resupply 
efficiently. Resupply is vital to prevent 
total annihilation.
choice_data_list: I see... As expected of Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...! This is like the most basic of 
basics.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is it seriously this late 
already...?! Ugh, jeez, I got way too 
caught up dealing with you...
choice_data_list: Thank you for being so polite, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't need any of that! I'm leaving 
already...!

Though I ended up irritating her in the 
end, I was able to play plenty of matches 
with Narita Taishin.
